text:
maria: Postmortem follow-up from yesterday — we keep seeing small but recurring outages that chain: cloud provider transient + auth token spikes -> model-registry timeouts -> user-facing error rate bump. Need clear remediation owners and timelines, plus a sensible cadence to surface regressions. Who can pick this up? :thinking:
aj: I can own the remediation tracker and run the owner rotations. I'll make a lightweight tracker (sheet) and add existing actions. Quick ask: can someone pull the last 90 days of incidents filtered by vendor (cloud, auth, model-registry)? :mag:
liam: I'll pull logs and produce a vendor-by-week heatmap. Will include time-of-day, scale correlation, and any pre-failure error patterns. ETA EOD.
sre_lead: Please also check circuit-breaker settings and autoscaler backoff behavior. If the cloud provider has transient error bursts, our circuit thresholds might be too permissive now. Also add a failure-mode column to the tracker (auth, registry, infra). :wrench:
kate: I'll map SLAs -> runbooks and call out gaps. If runbooks don't cover model-registry token expiry jitter or cross-region retry, we should add steps. ETA Tue morning.
security: Noted. I'll validate KMS rotation windows and model-registry token TTLs. There's been chatter about simultaneous token refreshes causing auth provider surge. If that's true, we should stagger rotations and add jitter. I'll report by Monday.
aj: Action items (quick list) — please ack and update owners:
- AJ: create remediation tracker (sheet + owner tags + status column) — due 2026-04-15
- LIAM: vendor heatmap + incident extracts (90d) — due 2026-04-13
- KATE: SLA->runbook gap doc + proposed edits — due 2026-04-14
- SECURITY: KMS/token rotation review & jitter proposal — due 2026-04-13
- SRE_LEAD: circuit-breaker + autoscaler config review — due 2026-04-16
- TEAM: schedule monthly "dependency failover" drill (synthetic traffic) — proposal by 2026-04-20
Please react with :white_check_mark: if you own an item.
liam: ack on mine. I'll attach the raw query and a small script to generate the heatmap. Example grep I used:
```
journalctl -u svc-model-registry | grep -E "(timeout|401|503)" | awk '{print $1,$2,$3,$NF}' > /tmp/registry-errors.log
python tools/heatmap.py /tmp/registry-errors.log --window 1d --vendor model-registry
```
This will go into the tracker as a link.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0413-07 linked to thread (postmortem-summary) — creating tracking item DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned to AJ.
sre_lead: Also proposing two mitigations we should evaluate in the short term:
1) Add per-route fallback to a cached model snapshot (v1-small) for 30s when registry latency > 200ms.
2) Implement a synthetic traffic canary that validates failover every 12 hours and reports to the console.
Snippet for the fallback rule we can add to the inference router:
```
if registry_latency_ms > 200 and error_rate > 0.02:
  route -> cached_snapshot:v1-small
  notify -> #incidents
```
kate: For the monthly drill: suggest running a scoped scenario "auth-provider burst" where we simulate auth token 500s and measure end-to-end SLA, time to failover, and alerting coverage. We'll record metrics: mean time to fallback, user error delta, and cost impact. I'll draft the drill runbook.
security: One more thing — vendor SLAs often exclude transient auth spikes. We should map our contractual SLA (RTO/RPO) to real runbook actions so we don't hunt during incidents. I'll add a vendor-SLA mapping tab in the tracker.
aj: Good. Let's also add a recurring ticket to the ops cadence: "monthly dependency resilience review" with owners rotating. If anybody wants to be on the on-call for that, mention here.
maria: Thanks, everyone. A few small asks before we close:
- Add link to the postmortem doc in the tracker
- Mark any "blocking" items (e.g., infra-level fallback) as high priority
- Confirm a short sync next Wednesday 09:00 to review heatmap + tracker
I'll set the calendar invite and add agenda: heatmap, runbook gaps, drill schedule. :calendar:
aj: I'll share the tracker link when ready and ping this thread. Planning to have the initial owner assignments done by EOD tomorrow.
maria: ack — leaving this thread open until Monday for first-round updates. If anything blocks you, tag @maria or @aj. :eyes:
